NOTE
**Ready for review**

The author pushed 12 times since the "not ready" label, which came with no written feedback. The PR now has a second commit that fixes the gitea test, and the author says the issue-vs-PR comment mix-up they found has been fixed.

|     |         |
| --- | ------- |
| ✅  | Template is filled in: description, how it was tested (on a live Forgejo instance), before/after screenshots, self-review checklist. |
| ✅  | CI passes, and the gitea test for PR comments was updated to match the new behavior. |
| ⚠️  | There is no linked issue; "Fixes:" is free text, so the "help wanted" rule can't be checked. |
| ℹ️  | The same author has an open PR, #40096 (gogs PR topic title), in the same area. A reviewer should check the two don't overlap. |

**Reviewer:** laurynmm — added the "not ready" label and is the person the author asked to review.

###### Next step

Remove "not ready", add "integration review", and assign laurynmm.

###### Reply

```quote
@laurynmm, could you review this? Also, @Alexis211, please note how this relates to #40096 so the two PRs don't overlap.
```
